name: Vahlarriel's Search
summary: Vahlarriel Demonslayer has come to Desolace to learn what became of two missing nobles of House Malem, a Darnassian merchant family. Their father fears the worst, and the last word of the pair places them in the Stonetalon Mountains some weeks back. Vahlarriel asks you to find their wagon.

sections.title: Two Missing Nobles
sections.body: Vahlarriel Demonslayer is looking for Tyranis and Dalinda Malem, whose father fears the worst and has charged Vahlarriel with doing everything possible to find them. The search has barely begun, and Vahlarriel hopes it will not keep them in Desolace long. The pair were last reported crossing the Stonetalon Mountains some weeks ago. Vahlarriel asks you to find their wagon in Desolace and to come at once when you do. Its charred remains lie there, with a chest among them.

sections.title: Among the Wreckage
sections.body: Rummaging through the wreck, you can tell the wagon fell to spells and weapons alike. The fight looks to have been brief and lopsided, with no blood and no bodies left behind. Whoever did this was efficient and swift.

faq.answer: Tyranis and Dalinda Malem, two nobles of House Malem, a Darnassian merchant family.

faq.q: Where were the siblings last heard from?
faq.answer: They were last reported crossing the Stonetalon Mountains some weeks before Vahlarriel spoke to you.
Their father fears the worst, and Vahlarriel has been charged with doing everything possible to find his missing children.

faq.q: What does Vahlarriel want you to find?
faq.answer: The wagon of Tyranis and Dalinda Malem in Desolace. If you find it, Vahlarriel asks you to come at once.
